title: Mahogany Ukulele Beginner Kit with Gig Bag, Tuner and Spare Strings
description:
A warm-sounding ukulele that is easy on the fingers, packed with everything a beginner needs to start playing straight away.
• Body: mahogany-look laminate top, back and sides with satin finish
• Choose soprano (21 in / 53 cm, 12 frets) or concert size (23 in / 58 cm, 18 frets)
• Included: padded gig bag, clip-on tuner, 1 set of spare nylon strings, 2 felt picks and a strap
• Geared tuning pegs that hold their tuning well

title: Acoustic Guitar 41 Inch with Spruce Top, Beginner Set with Gig Bag
description:
A full-size dreadnought acoustic guitar with a bright, full sound, set up with a low action so it is comfortable for new players.
• Body: spruce laminate top with basswood back and sides; 41 in (104 cm) long
• Neck: 20 frets with truss rod; die-cast tuning machines
• Steel strings fitted; 1 spare set included
• Also included: padded gig bag, strap, 3 picks and a cleaning cloth

title: Classical Guitar with Nylon Strings, 4/4 or 3/4 Size for Students
description:
A traditional classical guitar with soft nylon strings that are gentle on the fingertips, ideal for music lessons and fingerstyle playing.
• Sizes: 4/4 (39 in / 99 cm) for teens and adults, 3/4 (36 in / 91 cm) for children aged about 8–12
• Spruce laminate top, linden back and sides, rosewood-look fingerboard
• Wide classical neck with 19 frets and open-gear tuners
• Supplied with a thin carry bag

title: 61-Key Electronic Keyboard with Music Rest, Microphone and EU Adapter
description:
A portable keyboard with full-size keys and lots of built-in sounds and rhythms, great for learning songs at home.
• 61 full-size keys; 300 voices, 300 rhythms and 40 demo songs
• Record and playback, metronome and teaching mode
• Built-in stereo speakers, headphone output and USB-MIDI port
• Included: music rest, wired microphone and mains adapter with EU plug (can also run on 6 x AA batteries, not included)
• Size approx. 94 x 31 x 10 cm

title: 88-Key Digital Piano with Semi-Weighted Keys and Sustain Pedal, EU Plug
description:
A slim digital piano with a full 88-key range and touch-sensitive keys, for practising classical pieces without taking up much space.
• 88 full-size, semi-weighted, touch-sensitive keys
• 128-note polyphony with 20 voices, including grand piano, electric piano and organ
• 2 x 20 W speakers, dual headphone outputs and USB-MIDI connection
• Included: sustain pedal, music rest and power adapter with EU plug
• Size approx. 132 x 28 x 12 cm

title: Djembe Hand Drum 10 Inch, Carved Wood with Natural Skin Head
description:
A hand-carved djembe with a deep bass tone and crisp slaps, for drum circles, music lessons and jamming with friends.
• Head: 10 in (25 cm) natural goatskin, rope-tuned
• Body: carved hardwood, approx. 50 cm tall
• Tuning rope lets you tighten the head for a higher pitch
• Each drum is carved and finished by hand, so patterns vary slightly

title: Wooden Tambourine 8 Inch with Double Row of Metal Jingles
description:
A bright, lively tambourine for bands, choirs, classrooms and sing-alongs, with a drum head you can tap as well as shake.
• Diameter: 8 in (20 cm), wooden frame
• Double row of 16 steel jingles
• Synthetic drum head
• Finger hole in the frame for a secure grip

title: Kalimba Thumb Piano with 17 Keys, Solid Wood Body and Tuning Hammer
description:
A soothing, music-box-like instrument that anyone can learn quickly. Pluck the metal tines with your thumbs to play melodies and chords.
• 17 steel tines tuned to C major; notes engraved on each tine
• Body: solid wood with a sound hole for a warm, resonant tone
• Included: tuning hammer, note stickers, song book, cleaning cloth and storage bag
• Size approx. 18 x 13 x 4 cm

title: Diatonic Harmonica, 10 Holes, Stainless Steel Covers with Case
description:
A pocket-size harmonica for blues, folk and rock, with a responsive feel that suits beginners and more experienced players.
• 10 holes, 20 brass reeds; available in the keys of C, G and A
• Polished stainless steel cover plates and ABS comb
• Size approx. 10 x 2.6 x 2 cm
• Comes in a padded hard case

title: Soprano Recorder in C, Baroque Fingering, 3-Piece with Cleaning Rod
description:
A school recorder with a clear, steady tone that is easy to blow, the classic first wind instrument for music lessons.
• Soprano (descant) in C with baroque fingering
• Durable ABS resin in 3 parts for easy cleaning
• Included: cleaning rod, fingering chart and fabric bag
• Length approx. 32 cm; suitable for ages 6+

title: Student Flute in C, 16 Closed Holes, Nickel-Plated with Hard Case
description:
A reliable concert flute for beginners and school orchestras, with a smooth key action and an even tone across the range.
• Key of C, 16 closed holes with E mechanism
• Nickel-plated cupronickel body and keys
• Included: padded hard case, cleaning rod, cloth, gloves and screwdriver
• Total length approx. 67 cm

title: Student Trumpet in B Flat, Brass Lacquer Finish with Hard Case
description:
A full-size B flat trumpet for students and hobby players, with smooth valves and a bright, projecting sound.
• Key of B flat; yellow brass body with clear lacquer
• Bore 11.7 mm, bell diameter 123 mm
• Stainless steel piston valves
• Included: 7C mouthpiece, hard case, gloves, valve oil and cleaning cloth

title: Guitar Picks Set, 30 Celluloid Picks in Mixed Colours and Thicknesses
description:
A handy assortment of picks so you can find the feel you like for strumming, lead lines and bass.
• Contents: 30 picks in assorted pearloid colours
• Thicknesses: 0.46 mm, 0.71 mm, 0.81 mm, 0.96 mm and 1.2 mm (6 of each)
• Standard teardrop shape for acoustic, electric and bass guitar
• Includes a small tin for storage

title: Guitar Capo with Spring Trigger for Acoustic and Electric Guitars
description:
A quick-change capo that clamps on with one hand, so you can change key between songs in seconds.
• Lightweight aluminium alloy with silicone pads that protect the neck
• Spring-loaded trigger with even pressure across all 6 strings
• Fits most 6-string acoustic and electric guitars; also suitable for ukulele
• Clips onto the headstock when not in use

title: Acoustic Guitar Strings, Phosphor Bronze, 2 Sets in Light or Extra Light
description:
Fresh strings bring a dull guitar back to life. These phosphor bronze strings give a warm, balanced tone with a clear top end.
• Contents: 2 complete sets of 6 strings
• Gauges: Light 0.011–0.052 or Extra Light 0.010–0.047
• Phosphor bronze wound strings on a hexagonal steel core
• Each string individually sealed to keep it fresh

title: USB Condenser Microphone Kit with Boom Arm, Shock Mount and Pop Filter
description:
A complete desktop recording set for vocals, podcasts, streaming and voice-overs. Plug it into a USB port and start recording, no extra drivers needed.
• Cardioid condenser capsule, 16 mm; 24-bit / 192 kHz sampling rate
• USB connection to most PCs and laptops; 2.5 m cable included
• Included: adjustable scissor boom arm with desk clamp, shock mount, pop filter and foam windscreen
• Gain knob and mute button on the microphone body

title: Closed-Back Studio Headphones with 50 mm Drivers and 3 m Cable
description:
Over-ear monitoring headphones with a detailed, balanced sound for recording, mixing, practising an instrument or just listening.
• 50 mm neodymium drivers, 32 ohm impedance, 15 Hz–25 kHz
• Closed-back cups with soft protein-leather cushions that block outside noise
• Detachable 3 m coiled cable with 3.5 mm plug and 6.35 mm adapter
• Fold-flat ear cups and adjustable padded headband

title: Kids' 37-Key Electronic Keyboard with Microphone, Battery Powered
description:
A first keyboard sized for small hands, with fun instrument sounds, demo songs and a microphone for singing along.
• 37 mini keys with 8 instrument sounds, 8 rhythms and 6 demo songs
• Record and playback function with adjustable volume
• Built-in speakers and a wired microphone
• Runs on 4 x AA batteries (not included); size approx. 47 x 17 x 5 cm
• Ages 3+

title: Colourful Desk Hand Bells, Set of 8 Notes for Kids and Classrooms
description:
Tap-the-top bells in eight colours, each tuned to one note of the scale, so children can play simple tunes together right away.
• 8 bells tuned to a C major scale (C, D, E, F, G, A, B, C)
• Press the button on top to ring; colour-coded for easy song charts
• Metal bells on sturdy plastic bases, approx. 9 cm tall
• Includes a booklet with colour-coded songs
• Ages 3+

title: Wooden Maracas, Pair of Rumba Shakers for Kids and Adults
description:
Classic hand-turned shakers with a crisp, rattling sound, great for sing-alongs, music classes and adding rhythm to any song.
• Pair of maracas, each approx. 20 cm long
• Hardwood with a smooth lacquered finish
• Filled with seeds for a natural shaker sound; sealed so nothing can escape
• Ages 3+
